description: What happened since the last call, without screenshots: events the program was handed (keys, touches, chat, ...), everything it printed, errors (uncaught Lua errors and printError), how many screen updates occurred, engine stderr, and whether it is still running. Call it right after something unexpected to see why. Output is capped to the newest lines.

reset.description: Discard what has accumulated and return nothing.

name: craftos_trace
